reviews.x: Okay, this one is new to me. I’ve seen so many videos about these and with the corona virus shutdowns, I haven’t been in for a pedicure in much longer than I care to admit. I needed to try something. Arrived in a timely manner; 2 days sooner than initially quoted. Instructions are easy enough. I washed and dried my feet, then put these bad boys on. Recommended time is for 50-90 minutes; longer for feet more in need (my heels are so cracked and flakey I wasn’t about to have photographic evidence)

reviews.t: Beware if you have sensitive skin
reviews.x: I feel so bad writing this because I hate leaving bad reviews, but this product caused my feet to break out in such a bad itchy rash that I’m going to need to go to the doctor. Maybe they’re good for other people, but think twice if you have sensitive skin

reviews.t: Caution: Can cause itchiness in skin on side/top of feet
reviews.x: It worked fairly well, I followed the instructions and, other than my heels, my skin exfoliated and felt baby-smooth. The top and sides of my feet were irritated and itchy a few days after applying, and this lasted two weeks.  Since I still have some tough heels (they recommend using again after giving your skin a break) - I'm doing a second treatment. BUT, this time, instead of using the socks/booties as designed, I extracted all the liquid from the booties into a shallow plastic container. I m

reviews.t: Relaxing and functional! Works well against callus
reviews.x: These things really do work. Gets the dry skin, dead skin, callus out of the way absolutely outstanding. The whole process is pretty relaxing too, highly recommended!

The scent of this product is very strong. It left me a bit dizzy after using it. However this product really does work! My skin started to peel only 3 days after application. It definitely left my skin a lot smoother too. The only downside is the strength of the scent. For people who are sensitive to strong smells, I wouldn’t recommend this. Otherwise it’s a great product and really does work!

My wife made me buy these foot scrubs. The truth is, I didn't have much faith in them, especially since I didn't know this brand. It is very impressive, there it says that the feet will begin to peel in 3 to 5 days, but my skin began to peel the next day, little by little. My recommendation is that if you are going to use it, put a lot of cream on your feet during the peeling process, otherwise the skin is tight and itches a lot.

What i like about this product is that in comparison to another brand that  is my go to. I'm very pleased with the fact that instead of it taking 5 to 7 days for exfoliation of the dead skin to start peeling it only to 2 days after sitting with the booties on my feet . Also the packaging stated that you can reuse . Impressive  ... what I dislike about the product is that it was difficult to open.....  But the product is great.

reviews.t: Not like they used to make them!
reviews.x: I had bought these long ago, however, it seems the formula has changed?  The first time with the new version I left them on the recommended time and my heels barely peeled at all, it was mostly the arch and top of my foot that peeled.  The second time I thought I'd leave it an extra 20 mins or so, but that was a mistake as it burned my skin on the top of my foot, which stayed rough for about a month after that.

Sooo i saw beware if u have sensitive skin review and ignored it thinking i didnt have sensitive skin... i was oh so wrong. I use the foot mask no problem and the skin started peeling thats where the trouble came in. After peeling i noticed my foot started burning like crazy.  I will say the parts not irritated are super soft though so i guess thats a plus

reviews.t: Your feel are gonna peel like crazy.
reviews.x: These feel a little odd when you’re wearing them, like a slight tingling, but otherwise cool and moist like any other foot mask but just be prepared for the weeks to follow because your feet are going to peel like crazy. So if that’s what your looking for- these are for you.  My feet peeled for almost three weeks - not great during sandal season. And when they were finally done peeling, I don’t know if they were too much softer before. Won’t buy again. I’m gonna stick to regular moisturizing foo

reviews.t: Hurt my feet for a day
reviews.x: Feet got really tingly the next day after use and my skin got so tight it was painful. I iced my feet and took ibuprofen. My feet started peeling 2 days after initial application but it did nothing for my calluses.

reviews.t: Great product and value for price.
reviews.x: This product was great and had extra for other applications. Used it with my girlfriend since we’ve been indoors for months it was refreshing to try this at home. Took about a week of peeling but the result was great. I would say two applications should do it. But you also need to moisturize and keep Your feet hydrated and clean for it to show good results. This is just the first step in a detox of dead dry skin.

Pleasantly surprised how well it works. Used the foot masks on Friday night for the full 90 minutes, because my feet are very dry, and Monday my feet started to peel. It is Wednesday and I only have a few spots still peeling.  Will definitely buy this again

The first day after using the product my feet felt nice and smooth. The next day however the top of my foot is itchy and burning with red bumps. I'm not allergic to anything.  Wish I never bought it and can return the rest.

reviews.t: do not use if you have sensitive skin
reviews.x: after using the foot masks, my feet have been itchy and broken out in rashes. i was not allergic to anything in the ingredient lists. feet are blotchy all the way to the top of my ankle where the foot mask stop
This burned my feet. It's been 3 weeks and I'm still feeling the pain. It did not exfoliate the way it should of...and has left my feet raw and sore.

reviews.t: Works but I got a rash ... ugh
reviews.x: It did make my feet peel but I broke out in an itchy rash on the top of both my feet. Be careful what you order online
DO NOT BUY. I have a chemical burn up to my ankles. And I can’t find any contact info. DO NOT USE!!!!!!!!!
My feet turned red and were itchy it did not peel like it said .  Will never order again .
This broke me out all round my foot bad....real bad it's been a week still healing
It works pretty good but not so good for calluses but would recommend

After reading the reviews I decided to try this product and I must say I am pleased. I soaked our feet for about 30 minutes. Since my husbands feet were in real bad shape I bought some callus remover gel and applied it to the really thick areas and used a rasp. I have purchased this product in the past, went on during COVID time to repurchased and was sad to see they were out. Once back in stock, I jumped on to buy again. My toughest spot is ashy heels and tough skin. I put these booties on with socks over them do I can walk around, set the timer, and see an immediate difference. I keep looking for a cheaper option than the $25 Baby Foot. That is the only foot peel that's ever really worked for me. This one -- not so much.  It took about 8-10 days before I saw any peeling. Then it was agonizingly slow. I had gross scaly feet for a good two weeks, and even when they finally looked better, they still had some flaking on the sides. And when the peeling stopped -- only about half of the bottom of my feet had peeled. Since this came in a five-pack, I just applied a second one

claims.text: Many reviewers report the product effectively removes dead skin and calluses, leaving feet smoother.
Several reviewers experienced itching, burning, rashes, or irritation, especially those with sensitive skin.
Peeling typically begins within a few days of application, often faster than expected.
Some reviewers found the scent very strong or the sensation uncomfortable (tingling, tightness, pain).
A few reviewers noted the product did little for their heels or calluses, or that the formula seemed changed.
